description: This file defines a custom health check for an ASP.NET Core web application. The class HomePageHealthCheck implements the IHealthCheck interface and performs an HTTP request to the home page URL to verify if specific content (".NET Bot Black Sweatshirt") is present, indicating the site is healthy.

classes.name: HomePageHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements a health check that verifies the homepage contains a specific string to determine health status.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous check by requesting the home page URL and searches for a specific string to determine if the application is healthy.
